editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Deriv (formerly Binary.com) is a derivatives platform operating since 1999, scoring 6.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. MFSA Malta regulated with unique synthetic indices trading 24/7. $5 minimum deposit and 1:1000 leverage maximise accessibility. Multiple platforms including MT5 and Deriv Bot. Mid-tier regulation and synthetic index risks lower the trust score. Best for experienced derivatives traders wanting 24/7 synthetic markets.
